---
name: Task
about: Autonomous runner task — fill every required field before adding the ready-for-agent label
---

## Roadmap phase
<!-- Optional. Links this task to a roadmap phase for health check visibility.
     e.g. "Phase 8 — Multi-account Google support" or "Judgment quality — Agent-as-reviewer" -->

## Depends on
<!-- Optional. Declares an upstream dependency for branch stacking.
     e.g. "Depends on #12". Omit if none. -->

## Objective
<!-- Required. One paragraph: what the finished state looks like. -->

## Context
<!-- Required. Relevant docs, files, prior decisions. Link rather than repeat content. -->

## Current state
<!-- Required. Bugs: reproduction steps. Features: description of the gap or missing behaviour. -->

## Constraints
<!-- Optional. Files, commands, services, and actions that are off-limits for this task.
     e.g. "Do not modify ops/deploy.sh. Do not run git push directly." -->

## Acceptance criteria
<!-- Required. The runner skips issues without this section.
     Observable conditions that constitute success — one checkbox per condition. -->
- [ ]

## Verification
<!-- Required. How to confirm done: which tests to run, manual checks, commands to execute.
     e.g. "go test -race ./..., verify-completion.sh, confirm timer appears in systemctl list-timers" -->

## Escalation
<!-- Required. Conditions under which the agent must stop and file a needs-info comment.
     If none apply, write "None — use your judgment." -->

## Agent
<!-- Optional. Override the default agent for this task.
     e.g. "gemini". Omit to use the repo default (claude). -->
